name: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects, II
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects, volume II (1867-72): fourteen sermons on the Church, the Spirit and the Word, St. Vincent de Paul, the Blessed Sacrament, St. Alphonsus, truth before peace, the Disciples of the Holy Ghost, the foreign missions and the Negro mission, and St. Edmund.
desc_pt: Sermões sobre Assuntos Eclesiásticos, volume II (1867-72): catorze sermões sobre a Igreja, o Espírito e a Palavra, S. Vicente de Paulo, o Santíssimo Sacramento, S. Afonso, a verdade antes da paz, os Discípulos do Espírito Santo, as missões estrangeiras e a missão aos negros, e S. Edmundo.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1867)
edition: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects (vol. 2) (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1867), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The sermons; the contents, the errata and the index are dropped.
